About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.


Your Mission

We are looking for  our very first Procurement Lead to join BlaBlaCar on a Permanent contract (CDI). 

Up until now, BlaBlaCar’s procurement grew fast and decentralized. Today, we manage ~€30m annual spend across 250+ passionate internal contract owners in 21 countries. To support our scale and ambitious roadmap, we are creating this dedicated role from scratch!

Your mission is a true 0-to-1 challenge: build, structure, and scale our global procurement framework, drive major high-stakes negotiations (payments, strategic SaaS), and set up modern third-party compliance guardrails across our international hubs.

Reporting directly to Lydie Convert (Head of Cash - department of 5 people), you will have the autonomy to shape BlaBlaCar’s procurement function, set priorities, and drive strategic negotiations. Sitting within the Finance (40 people), your role will span the business, working closely with teams across all departments, all entities.

You will build this function with the active support of Finance, Legal, Security, Tech, and business owners, drawing on their expertise while owning the procurement roadmap and leading its implementation. This is an opportunity to combine independent ownership with strong cross-functional collaboration and deliver tangible business impact.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead strategic high-stakes negotiations: Partner directly with leadership and tech owners to lead critical Group tenders (such as Payin, Payout, payment orchestration, and major software). Bring commercial savvy to the table, acting as our constructive "deal partner" to unlock meaningful financial ROI and top-tier SLAs.

  • Build our procurement framework: Create and roll out our internal "RFP Kit" (playbooks, pragmatic scoring matrices, transparent RACI, and ethical code of conduct). Help over 250 contract owners run standard tenders with autonomy, agility, and confidence.

  • Establish a smart third-party compliance filter: Design and automate our third-party onboarding gatekeeper across our systems (Juro, Workday, Kyriba). Partner closely with Legal and Security to screen partners smoothly before commitments are signed or cash leaves our accounts.

  • Master contract lifecycles & eliminate surprise renewals: Build and lead a proactive contract radar. Flag key expiring agreements at M-6 to give business owners ample runway to renegotiate, optimize pricing, and guarantee protective terms without friction.

  • Champion vendor governance & executive reporting: Conduct periodic reviews on active key vendors and deliver crisp quarterly insights (cost savings generated, supplier risks tackled, ROI delivered) directly to our CFO, ExCo, and Audit Committee.

    • Your qualifications

  • Solid background in indirect procurement, RFP orchestration, and commercial negotiations within fast-paced, international environments.

  • Strong organizational rigor and structured methodology: proven ability to design clear processes from scratch, balance agility with audit-readiness, and drive data-backed decisions. 

  • Solid practical understanding of vendor risk, compliance guardrails, and regulatory standards (KYC/KYB, Sapin II, sanctions).

  • A pragmatic "business enabler" mindset: you love building simple, frictionless processes that empower teams rather than slow them down.

  • Full working proficiency in English

  • Fit with our BlaBlaPrinciples

  • Thriving in a collaborative, fast-growing and innovative environment

  • Ability to take ownership, aligned with business priorities  

  • Nice to have: 

  • Experience working with finance and contract tools such as Workday or Juro.

  • Experience navigating supplier ecosystems or regulatory nuances in high-growth emerging markets.

    • What we have to offer

  • Paris or Full-remote from anywhere in France

  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

  • Financial support for home office equipment

  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year 

  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

  • Relocation package and visa support

  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

  • Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility opportunities

  • Employee Stock ownership plan

  • Regular team building events

  • 1 day off per year to test our product

    • Interested in joining the ride?

  • a 45-min video-call with your Talent Acquisition Manager Hien Hoang to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • a 60-min video-call with your N+1 Lydie Convert to discuss the vision, team organization, and scope.

  • a fully remote business case to evaluate your negotiation strategy, RFP framing, and compliance prioritization skills.

  • a 60-min video call with the hiring manager and a cross-functional peer (Legal/Finance) to deep-dive into your case study.

  • a 30-min video-call with our CFO for vision fit and rounding off the process. 

    • Our hiring process lasts on average 25-30 days, offers usually come within 48 hours.

     

     

    BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
